cases.question: Which company reported higher net income in fiscal 2025, Apple or Microsoft?
cases.answer: Apple reported a higher net income in fiscal 2025 with $112,010 million [Source: Apple Annual Report FY2025, p.32] compared to Microsoft's net income of $101,832 million [Source: Microsoft Annual Report FY2025, p.53].
